summary: Cache scoped HTTP reads across providers

delivery.outcome: Cache repeated successful provider reads with TTL, response policy, process coalescing, fresh bypass and fenced invalidation; preserve account separation
nonGoals: Caching mutations, streaming or authorization decisions
Dependency version changes or publication of pre-existing unrelated commits

architecture.decision: Reuse the canonical procache SQLite backend and explicit request identity; use generation keys so a pre-mutation loader cannot repopulate a current read
interfaceChanges: Add optional scoped HTTP read adapter
architecture.rollback: Revert the exact implementation through protected delivery

validation.evidence: Tests cover cache hits, credential isolation, invalidation, live bypass and failure behavior
